346–348: Native Arelle and the pdfplumber comparator have bounded source selections. Documentary exchanges and necessary Pillow/Python intersections do not establish a resolved or tested runtime. The short final page is an ordinary chapter end. Chapter13 is complete; no additional defect confirmed.
